speaker: Sheldon
text: You're here a lot now. Thank you. Chocolate?

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, am I talking too much? I'm sorry. Zip. Yes, please.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh. Hey, Kim. Yeah, I... You know what? Hold on, let me take this in the hall.

speaker: Penny
text: You'll never guess who they got to replace him.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Okay. I know what you're doing. Really?

speaker: Leonard
text: Yes. You're using chocolates as positive reinforcement for what you consider correct behavior. Sheldon, you can't train my girlfriend like a lab rat.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Actually, it turns out I can.

speaker: Sheldon
text: There's just no pleasing you, is there, Leonard? You weren't happy with my previous approach to dealing with her, so I decided to employ operant conditioning techniques, building on the works of Thorndike and B.F. Skinner.

speaker: Sheldon
text: By this time next week, I believe I can have her jumping out of a pool, balancing a beach ball on her nose.

speaker: Leonard
text: No. This has to stop now.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I'm not suggesting we really make her jump out of a pool. I thought the Bazinga was implied. We're just tweaking her personality. Sanding off the rough edges, if you will.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Are you saying that I am forbidden from applying a harmless, scientifically valid protocol that will make our lives better?
